stem: It is known that 8% of adults in a certain town own a Chantor car. After an advertising campaign, a car dealer wishes to investigate whether this proportion has increased. He chooses a random sample of 25 adults from the town and notes how many of them own a Chantor car.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
He finds that 4 of the 25 adults own a Chantor car.

Carry out a hypothesis test at the 5% significance level.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain which of the errors, Type I or Type II, might have been made in carrying out the test in part **(a)**.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: Later, the car dealer takes another random sample of 25 adults from the town and carries out a similar hypothesis test at the 5% significance level.
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type I error.
